# AURA E-Commerce Platform

> Premium High-Fidelity Audio Hardware & Accessories

## Overview
AURA is an enterprise e-commerce platform specializing in high-fidelity audio equipment, planar headphones, studio IEMs, and custom audio hardware.

## Key Sections
- [Products](/products): Browse planar magnetic headphones, DACs, and audio accessories.
- [Categories](/categories): Shop by category including Audio, Tech, and Accessories.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Read articles, technical guides, and release announcements.
- [Offers](/offers): Exclusive promotional discounts and bundle deals.
- [Contact](/contact): 24/7 Concierge and customer support.

## API & Agentic Access
- Structured JSON API endpoints are accessible under `/api/` for product discovery, search, and support integration.
